Amazon AI shopping agent: let an AI agent find, compare and buy on Amazon for you | Reduck Reduck raised $3M in pre-seed funding. Watch the announcement Use cases Scripts Pricing Blog Docs Community Sign In Use cases Amazon AI shopping agent E-Commerce Reduck MCP Updated Oct 28, 2026 Amazon AI shopping agent: let an AI agent find, compare and buy on Amazon for you Prompt template Find the best product on Amazon under budget , based on recent reviews. Show me your pick and the checkout (address, delivery date, total), and place the order when I say yes. Get started for free Overview People who buy on Amazon for themselves, and office managers who order supplies for a team, want the right product within their budget, and want to check the order before they pay. To get there, they compare a dozen listings, read the reviews to find the problem nobody mentions in the title, and then go through checkout to check the address, the delivery date and the total. Why it's hard Amazon has no API for shoppers. The ratings hide as much as they show, and the detail that decides it is often on page three of the reviews. Checkout also changes from one order to the next: another address can be selected, delivery options change the price, and import fees can appear. An agent that only finds a product leaves all of this to you, and an agent that buys without showing you the checkout is not one you can trust with your card. How Reduck does it Your AI agent works in your own browser, where you are already signed in to Amazon. It searches the category, compares the listings and reads the recent reviews, so its pick comes with reasons, not only a rating. Then it opens the checkout for that product and shows you what Amazon shows: the delivery address, the payment method, the delivery options and the order total. You say yes, and it places the order and gives you the order number. You say no, and nothing is bought. What your agent does Search Amazon for the product you describe, within your budget Read the recent reviews of the best candidates and keep the recurring points Tell you its pick and why Open the checkout and show you the address, the payment method, the delivery date and the total Place the order when you confirm, and give you the order number Tell you if your bank asks you to approve the payment, and cancel the order if you change your mind before it ships Who it's for Anyone who wants the research and the checkout done, but keeps the last word Busy people who buy the same kinds of things again and again Ops and office managers who order supplies for a team Scripts used Search products Amazon Get product reviews Amazon Buy now Amazon Get checkout information Amazon Place order Amazon Cancel order Amazon FAQ Will it buy something without asking me? No. Your agent stops on the checkout page and shows you what Amazon shows: the address, the payment method, the delivery options and the order total. It places the order only after you confirm. Which address and card does it use? The ones saved in your Amazon account, the same ones you see at checkout. Your agent reads them back to you before it orders, so you can check them. What if my bank asks me to approve the payment? Some banks ask for an approval in their app (3-D Secure). Your agent tells you when that happens, and gives you the order number, so you can approve it or cancel the order. Can I cancel an order my agent placed? Yes. While the order has not shipped, your agent can cancel it from Your Orders, like you would. Does this need the Amazon API? No. Your agent works in your own signed-in browser, on the same pages you would open yourself. Can it reorder things I buy often? Yes. Ask your agent to reorder something you bought before, and it finds the product, opens the checkout and waits for your yes. For the same items on a fixed schedule, Amazon's own Subscribe & Save is simpler. Is an AI agent allowed to shop on Amazon for me? Your agent works in your own browser, signed in as you, and every order is one you confirm at checkout, like shopping yourself. Amazon's Conditions of Use apply to you as they always do; decide whether that fits how you use your account. Does it just trust the star rating? No. It reads the recent reviews and tells you the points that come back again and again, good and bad. Export a LinkedIn Sales Navigator Lead List to CSV or Google Sheets with Claude or ChatGPT (2026) | Reduck Reduck raised $3M in pre-seed funding. Watch the announcement Use cases Scripts Pricing Blog Docs Community Sign In Use cases Export Sales Navigator leads Growth hacking Reduck MCP Updated Oct 28, 2026 Export a LinkedIn Sales Navigator Lead List to CSV or Google Sheets with Claude or ChatGPT (2026) Prompt template Export my Sales Navigator lead list list name to a CSV with each lead's name, title, company, location and Sales Navigator link. Get started for free Can you export leads from Sales Navigator natively? No. LinkedIn's Sales Navigator help says there is no option to export account and lead information into a CSV or XLS file. Sales Navigator lets you read a lead list page by page, but there is no export button: no CSV, no Excel, no Google Sheets. The only native route is CRM Sync, on the Advanced Plus plan only, into Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or HubSpot. The usual answer is a paid Chrome extension such as Evaboot or Skrapp. How to export a Sales Navigator lead list to CSV or Google Sheets Reduck reads Sales Navigator in your own Chrome, where your seat is already signed in, and your AI agent does the export: Install the Reduck extension in Chrome and stay signed in to LinkedIn there, with your Sales Navigator seat. Add Reduck to your client: Claude Code , Claude Desktop , ChatGPT or any other MCP client . Ask: "Export my Sales Navigator lead list 'VP Sales – SaaS – France' to a Google Sheet with name, title, company, location and link." The agent lists your lead lists with sales_navigator_list_lead_lists, then sales_navigator_export_lead_list reads every page of the one you name and returns each lead with a complete flag. The agent writes the rows to a CSV, or into a Google Sheet with sheets_write_cells. Export a saved lead list or a live search A saved lead list exports whole, up to 5,000 leads by default. To start from a search instead, sales_navigator_search_people runs it with Sales Navigator's filters, 25 results a page, and the agent can save the results into a new lead list, then export that list. One search shows at most 2,500 results: split a bigger one by location, headcount or seniority. If what you need is the lead list itself, with names, titles, companies, locations and Sales Navigator links, in a CSV or a Google Sheet, Reduck exports it from your own seat, with a free tier. Who it's for Sales teams who build lists in Sales Navigator and work them in a sheet or a sequencer Founders running their own outbound with Claude or ChatGPT Agencies who hand a client their Sales Navigator list as a file Scripts used List lead lists Sales Navigator Export lead list Sales Navigator Search people Sales Navigator Get lead Sales Navigator Create lead list Sales Navigator Save lead to list Sales Navigator Write cells Google Sheets FAQ Can you export leads from Sales Navigator natively? No. LinkedIn's Sales Navigator help says it does not offer an option to export account and lead information into a CSV or XLS file. On the Advanced Plus plan, CRM Sync links leads and accounts with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or HubSpot, and you export from the CRM. On Core and Advanced there is no export at all, so a lead list in a spreadsheet means copying it by hand or a tool that reads it for you. Is there a free way to export Sales Navigator leads without Evaboot? Yes. Copying leads by hand into a sheet is free, and Evaboot's own guide calls that the free method. Evaboot itself has no free tier: its guide lists it at $29 to $299 a month. Reduck has a free tier, and one export of a whole lead list is one run, so you can export lists to CSV or Google Sheets on it. You still need your own Sales Navigator seat, and Reduck does not add email addresses. Can I export Sales Navigator leads straight to Google Sheets? Yes. Your agent exports the list with sales_navigator_export_lead_list, then writes the rows into a Google Sheet with sheets_write_cells, in the same Chrome where you are signed in to Google. No CSV import step is needed. If you prefer a file, ask for a CSV instead and import it with File, Import in Google Sheets. Does it export the whole list, or only the first page? The whole list. sales_navigator_export_lead_list pages through the list (25 leads per request by default) until it has every lead, up to 5,000 by default. It returns the list's total and a complete flag: complete is false when the export stopped early, so a partial file is never mistaken for the whole list. Which fields do I get for each lead? From a lead list: first and last name, current title and company, location, connection degree, the Sales Navigator lead link, the date the lead was added to the list, how many of your lists hold the lead, and the CRM status. From a search: name, title, company, industry, location, tenure, summary and the lead link. sales_navigator_get_lead adds the full position history for any lead. Does it find email addresses? No. Reduck exports what Sales Navigator shows you. Contact details come only for leads your seat has unlocked. Some extensions add one: Skrapp's guide says its extension returns a found and verified email for each lead, for credits. If you need emails, export the list with Reduck and run it through an email finder, or use one of those tools. Can my agent build the list too, not only export it? Yes. sales_navigator_search_people runs a search with Sales Navigator's filters (title, location, seniority, function, company headcount, years in role and more), 25 results a page. sales_navigator_create_lead_list makes a new list, and sales_navigator_save_lead_to_list saves leads into it. These two change your account, so your agent asks before running them. Is there a limit on how many leads a search returns? Sales Navigator shows at most 2,500 results for one search. This limit is LinkedIn's, so every tool hits it. Split a bigger search into narrower ones, by location, headcount or seniority, and save the leads to one list, then export the list. Is this allowed by LinkedIn, and what about GDPR? LinkedIn's User Agreement prohibits scraping, and no tool can promise that LinkedIn will never act on an account. Reduck does not run a crawler: each script runs only when you or your agent asks, in your own Chrome, with your own seat. Get started for free Overview Sourcing and market maps start the same way: a list of companies that fit a thesis, then the work of enriching each one with funding, investors and what's been written about them lately. The data is spread across several platforms, most of it gated, and copying it into a sheet by hand is slow and goes stale the week after. Why it's hard Crunchbase's free tier returns at most 15 companies for one filtered search, and shows only the 10 most recent news items for a company. Dealroom keeps a company's funding rounds, investors and valuation on that company's own profile page, so you open one page per company. Each platform has its own search and its own company pages, so joining a company across them, then chasing its rounds, its investors and its news, is many tabs for one row in a spreadsheet. How Reduck does it Reduck runs the search in your own session on each platform, then follows each company through to its funding history, investors and recent coverage, and brings it back as one structured set. Your agent does the joining across sources so you get a filled-in list instead of a pile of tabs. The same prompt refreshes the whole map whenever you need it current. What your agent does Search each database by industry, stage, location and founded date Pull each company's funding rounds, total raised and lead investors Add the founders, key people and board where available Gather recent news and press mentions for each one Return it as one structured list, ready for a sheet or CRM Who it's for Investors sourcing and mapping a space Founders sizing up a market or competitors Analysts and operators keeping a watchlist current Scripts used Search companies Crunchbase Get company profile Dealroom Get company news Crunchbase FAQ Do I need a paid seat on these platforms? No. It works in your own session with the access you already have, within each platform's own free limits. How does it match a company across sources? Your agent searches each database, then follows the matching company through to its profile, rounds and news, and returns them joined on one row. How fresh is the funding data? It reads what each source shows live at run time, so a rerun gives you the current picture. Where does the list end up? As one structured set you can drop into a sheet or CRM.
